title: BCIAUT-P300 dataset for autism from Simoes et al 2020
description: The BCIAUT-P300 dataset comprises EEG recordings from 15 individuals with autism spectrum disorder (ASD) participating in a P300-based brain-computer interface (BCI) study focused on joint-attention training in a virtual environment. Data were collected across 7 sessions using 8 EEG channels sampled at 250 Hz, with visual stimuli presented as flashing objects. This multi-session, multi-subject benchmark dataset enables evaluation of P300 detection algorithms and BCI performance in the clinical ASD population.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a g.Nautilus wireless system (g.tec) with 8 channels (C3, Cz, C4, CPz, P3, Pz, P4, POz) referenced to the right ear and grounded at AFz. Sampling rate was 250 Hz with a 50 Hz line frequency. Participants completed 7 sessions of P300 BCI training with visual feedback, involving 2 runs per session with flashing object stimuli. Data were preprocessed and epoched with a trial interval of [0, 1.2] seconds.
